summary: Add granularity-awareness instruction to AGENT_SYSTEM to prevent anatomical system/region mismatches.

edits.hypothesis: Adding a specific instruction to prefer standard radiological region names (e.g., 'Chest') over physiological system names (e.g., 'Respiratory system') when answering questions about image content will fix the granularity mismatch failure mode observed in q000016.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: This is a semantic preference issue that requires explicit guidance in the system prompt; control flow or memory changes cannot correct the model's inherent tendency to map visual features to physiological systems instead of anatomical regions without this directive.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000016, the agent answered 'Respiratory system' instead of 'Chest'. With this instruction, it would be guided to use the precise anatomical label 'Chest' as required by the dataset convention. (preservative) This instruction is conditional on questions about anatomical regions/systems and does not affect binary disease detection tasks like q000001 or q000008. (transfer) Generalizes to any medical imaging task where dataset labels follow specific anatomical naming conventions rather than physiological ones.
edits.regression_risk: Minimal risk; the instruction is specific to anatomical/organ system questions and uses tentative language ('prefer... unless explicitly asked').
edits.mechanism: Adding a specific instruction to prefer standard radiological region names (e.g., 'Chest') over physiological system names (e.g., 'Respiratory system') when answering questions about image content will fix the granularity mismatch failure mode observed in q000016.
